landing.heroSubtitle: Instantly alert the people you trust, share your location, and find nearby emergency help.
landing.heroNote: Available in English, Hindi and Odia. Works on any phone browser, and installs like an app.

demo.tryAria: Demo SOS button. Press and hold for 2 seconds to see what happens. Nothing is sent.
demo.hint: Try it: press and hold SOS. This is a simulation, nothing is sent.

how.title: Three steps, and only the first one is yours.
how.s1Body: Hold the button for two seconds, or tap it three times. No menus, no forms, no second confirmation.
how.s2Body: Parents, siblings and friends get an SMS, email and push alert at the same time, in their own language.
how.s3: Share your live location and get nearby help
how.s3Body: They open a private link with your live location. You see police stations, hospitals and one-tap helplines.

landing.featuresTitle: Built for the worst moment, useful every day.

f.sosBody: One gesture sends the alert. Works with one hand, by keyboard, and with screen readers.
f.contactsBody: Up to 10 people, notified at the same time by SMS, email and push. Test messages confirm it works.
f.liveBody: A private link that updates while you need it and stops when you're safe. No account needed to open it.
f.policeBody: The closest police stations, sorted by distance, with call and directions.
f.hospitalsBody: Hospitals, clinics and pharmacies around you, with opening hours where known.
f.helplinesBody: 112, 181, 1091, 1098 and more, with what each number is for and where it works.
f.journeyBody: Set a destination and arrival time. If you don't arrive, your chosen contacts are alerted.
f.checkinBody: Set an "I'm safe" timer for a date, a cab or a late walk home. Miss it, and Raksha reaches out.

landing.languages: English, हिन्दी and ଓଡ଼ିଆ. Alerts reach each contact in their own language.

honest.title: Honest about what a website can do.
honest.body: Raksha works in your phone's browser and installs like an app. Some things only a native app can do, and we won't pretend otherwise.
honest.p1: Raksha never calls the police automatically. Your trusted contacts are alerted first, and you choose who to call.
honest.p2: Location links are random, private and temporary. They stop showing your location the moment you're safe.
honest.p3: Hardware button emergency activation (power or volume buttons) requires the Raksha Android app. Browsers cannot detect those buttons.
honest.p4: With no internet, Raksha saves your alert and sends it when the network returns, and keeps calling and SMS one tap away.
